q1_issues.issue: "Money" is a bare kind-denoting mass NP, so "can change" is a capability generic over a kind, which the instruction set routes to the kind-level reified capability property at empirical generic truth values, not to an event bundle carrying (Can e) at 1.0/0.99.

The indefinite argument "a person" is stored as the bare class symbol person, but in event form an indefinite must mint a fresh witness with its own class atom (the bare class symbol is reserved for non-specific/generic objects).
"in a few minutes" bounds how quickly the change can happen, yet (MeasureAtLeast sk_change_1 duration 2 minute) asserts a lower bound of at least two minutes that the sentence never states.

q2_gaps: frame adverbial "in <time-span>" (the span within which an event completes) — Time/Measures covers "for"-durations, interval Start/End and bounded TimeAtLeast/AtMost, but not the completion-window reading of "in"

vague-quantity duration ("a few minutes", "several hours") — CardinalityPhrase records a vague count of things, but there is no vague-magnitude form for a measure, so only the bare-plural "for days" rule (at least 2) is available and it does not fit "a few"
notes: Every head used is licensed; the defects are construction choice, not vocabulary. Agent for the inanimate transitive subject and Patient for the changed object are both correct.
